sections.title: "Every" as one word
sections.content: Instead of saying "every day" as two words, Hungarian often uses a single suffixed adverb: naponta (daily/every day), hetente (weekly/every week), havonta (monthly/every month), évente (yearly/every year). Build them from nap (day), hét (week), hó/hónap (month) and év (year) — you already know all four nouns.

items.english: I go to the cinema once a month.

sections.content: havonta looks unrelated to hónap at first glance because it's built from the older, shorter form hó rather than hónap — both mean "month", and you'll see hó show up in exactly this kind of fixed expression.
